notes: Both כֻּלָּם pairs are split as כֹּל → 'all' beside suffix → 'of them', headed on the pronoun, per rule 19's explicit ruling against an 'all of' treatment.
Both object markers are unrepresented: the ASV writes 'thee' and 'all thine army' without spending a word on the object relation (rule 16).

The 'in' of 'in full armor' is equally readable as rule 19's recast construct relation, since מִכְלוֹל is the nomen rectum of the construct adjective לְבֻשֵׁי, rather than as rule 33's supplied word on an adverbial accusative. Both readings put it in the same unit with the same head, so the alignment is unaffected; the unit's own note already records the competing head reading ('armor' rather than 'full').
Six waws against six ASV 'and's, and no 'the' anywhere in the verse — both counts balance.
